page.title: The Great Build Scavenger Hunt: Roblox Event Guide
page.meta_description: Roblox The Great Build Scavenger Hunt guide: event dates, how the hunt unlocks the Cloudtop Tower, obby and time trial rewards, and free item tips.
page.tagline: A five-day Roblox tower event where the scavenger hunt helps you earn free avatar items.
overview: The Great Build Scavenger Hunt is one of the challenges inside The Great Build, a Roblox Thanksgiving event built around a shared community tower. The event runs for five days, from November 25 to November 30, and asks players to complete challenges and contribute blocks to unlock free avatar items. Finishing the scavenger hunt unlocks the Cloudtop Tower hat.

The main loop is simple: claim a block from the central Block Giver, write a gratitude note using prompts like “I’m grateful for…” or “I’m thankful for…,” and add it to the tower. You can claim one block every hour, and the cooldown timer is shown on screen. Clicking blocks in the tower opens cards with other players’ notes and usernames.

Beyond the tower, the event includes an obby, a scavenger hunt, and a time trial. The obby has checkpoints and hazard blocks, and reaching the top unlocks the Skybound Monarch item. The scavenger hunt unlocks Cloudtop Tower, and the time trial unlocks Cloudbreaker Horns. Building five blocks and hitting community milestones adds more rewards, including Patchbrick Cap, Snowcapped Brick Tails, The Ascendant Bloom, and Brick & Pebble. After finishing the obby, you can fly around the lobby map.

how_to_play: Join The Great Build on Roblox using the event game link.
Find the central Block Giver and claim your block. The station has an hourly cooldown, shown on screen.
Open the “Build a Block” prompt and pick a gratitude sentence starter, such as “I’m grateful for…,” “I’m thankful for…,” “I’m inspired by…,” or “Something that makes me smile is….”
Choose a category for your note, such as Family, Community, Nature & Weather, Food & Gathering, Hobbies, Places, or Roblox, then place the block on the community tower.
Click blocks in the tower to read other players’ notes and usernames.
Start the obby from its marked platform, clear the moving and disappearing blocks and lava hazards, and hit the checkpoints. Reaching the top completes the obby and unlocks Skybound Monarch.
Complete the scavenger hunt to unlock the Cloudtop Tower hat.
Complete the time trial to unlock Cloudbreaker Horns.

Build at least five blocks and keep an eye on the community goal tracker. At 1,000,000 blocks you can earn Patchbrick Cap; at 5,000,000 blocks, Snowcapped Brick Tails; at 20,000,000 blocks, The Ascendant Bloom. Brick & Pebble is also tied to a community milestone.
After finishing the obby, use the flight toggle and on-screen flight buttons to explore the lobby.

tips: Claim your block as soon as the hourly cooldown ends so you can stack notes toward the build-five requirement.
Use the gratitude prompts and categories to write notes quickly; you can choose Roblox-specific topics like games, developers, creators, or a favorite influencer.
Click tower blocks while you wait for cooldowns; it’s the fastest way to see how other players are using the prompts.
In the obby, treat orange blocks as hazards and use checkpoints to avoid losing progress.
Finish the obby early to unlock flight, which makes exploring the lobby and finding event areas easier.
Check the community goal tracker before you leave; milestone rewards depend on the global community total, not just your blocks.
If you’re chasing Cloudtop Tower, do the scavenger hunt before the event ends on November 30.

faq.q: What is The Great Build Scavenger Hunt?
faq.a: It’s a challenge in the Roblox The Great Build event. Completing the scavenger hunt unlocks the Cloudtop Tower hat.

faq.q: When is The Great Build event?
faq.a: The event runs for five days, from November 25 to November 30.

faq.q: How do you get the Cloudtop Tower hat?
How do you earn free items in The Great Build?
faq.a: Complete the obby for Skybound Monarch, the scavenger hunt for Cloudtop Tower, and the time trial for Cloudbreaker Horns. Build five blocks and hit community milestones for Patchbrick Cap, Snowcapped Brick Tails, The Ascendant Bloom, and Brick & Pebble.

faq.q: How often can you claim a block?
faq.a: Once per hour from the central Block Giver; the cooldown timer is displayed on screen.

faq.q: Do you need to build blocks for rewards?
faq.a: Yes. Several milestone items require you to build five blocks on the tower and for the community to reach a block total.

The guide lists 1,000,000 blocks for Patchbrick Cap, 5,000,000 blocks for Snowcapped Brick Tails, and 20,000,000 blocks for The Ascendant Bloom, each with five personal blocks built. Brick & Pebble is also tied to a community milestone.

faq.q: Can you fly in The Great Build?
faq.a: Yes. Completing the obby unlocks flight around the lobby map, with on-screen Fly, Ascend, Descend, and Sprint buttons.

faq.q: Where do you play The Great Build?
faq.a: On Roblox via the event game page: https://www.roblox.com/games/98487757108234/The-Great-Build.
